_comment: v11 parsing-aligned ontology profile. Additions preserve original group names and 12 original relation names.
Place this manifest under ontology/slice_manifest.json, and matsci-v11-parsing-aligned-cleaned.owl in the same ontology/ directory.
Roots accept IRIs or labels. Prefer full IRIs; ambiguous labels generate warnings.
Deprecated named classes/properties are excluded from LLM choices by default (see exclude_deprecated).
Scientific context is typed by domain instead of placing all generically dependent continuants in OTHER.
Class labels serve as LLM display labels; ontology IRIs remain the canonical identifiers.
Record-layer properties (wasMeasuredOn, hasReportedPropertyValue) require reified measurement/value records to satisfy their declared domains/ranges.

material.description: Chemical identity of a substance: a compound or element (e.g. Ba1-xKxBiO3, Bi2O3, KOH, Te as a dopant), or a material class (semiconductor, crystalline material).

sample.description: A specific physical specimen made or measured in this paper (a single crystal, a crystal batch, a flake, a film, a device), identified by its process history.

process.description: Steps that create or modify a sample (crystal growth: flux, chemical vapour transport, electrochemical, Bridgman; annealing, doping, quenching, exfoliation, polishing, simulation).

process_attribute.description: Kinds of process parameters (temperature, pressure, duration, gas flow, power, atmosphere...).

technique.description: Measurement / characterization / computational methods (XRD, magnetic susceptibility, resistivity, ARPES, STM, heat capacity, DFT).

property.description: Measured or computed properties (critical temperature, carrier lifetime, magnetic susceptibility, lattice parameter, residual resistivity ratio).

application.description: Reported or proposed use of a material/device (spintronics, photovoltaics, batteries, sensing, etc.); distinguish proposed vs demonstrated in application status.

phenomenon.description: Scientific phenomena (AHE, magnetoresistance, superconductivity, WAL, etc.)

mechanism.description: Proposed or established physical mechanisms and interactions

instrument.description: Measurement or process instrument and model names

software.description: Software packages, programs, versions, electronic structure tools

phase.description: Physical, structural, magnetic, electronic and other material phases

structure.description: Crystal structure and motifs, space groups, kagome lattices

reference.description: External papers, citations, references and identifiers

dataset.description: Experimental/computational datasets, repositories and data products

other.description: Reserved for truly uncategorized domain objects, e.g. charge carriers or data products. Prefer explicit scientific_context groups and unresolved_terms for new words.

unmapped.description: Unknown scientific words, acronyms, provisional concepts for expert review

relations.name: has_input
relations.definition: A process step consumes or modifies this sample/material.

relations.name: has_output
relations.definition: A process step produces this sample.

relations.name: precedes
relations.definition: One process step happens before another in the same sample's history.

relations.name: has_parameter
relations.definition: A process step is run with this parameter value.

relations.name: measured_on
relations.definition: A measurement was performed on this sample.
relations.mapping_note: Record-level only: wasMeasuredOn requires a ScientificMeasurementRecord as subject and a MaterialMention as object; do not assert on a technique class.

relations.name: has_property_value
relations.definition: A sample has a reported value of a property.
relations.mapping_note: Record-level only: hasReportedPropertyValue points from a ScientificExtractionRecord to a ScientificValueRecord, not a raw numeric literal or a material-property class.

relations.name: part_of
relations.definition: A layer/component is physically part of a larger sample or device (e.g. a NbSe2 flake is part of a van der Waals heterostructure device).

relations.name: composed_of
relations.definition: A sample is made of / contains this material (e.g. a Te-doped PtBi2 crystal composed of PtBi2 with Te as dopant).
relations.mapping_note: BFO has part captures physical part-whole only. Stoichiometric occupancy is modeled separately using literature:hasOccupancy.

relations.name: intended_for
relations.definition: The paper states the material or device is developed or used for this application.
relations.mapping_note: Intended application claim, not an asserted realized function.

relations.name: influences
relations.definition: The paper reports that changing a process parameter or step changes a property (give the trend).
relations.mapping_note: Broad evidence-qualified influence, not automatic causality; record trend, conditions, polarity and evidence.

relations.name: derived_from
relations.definition: A sample was made from another sample (e.g. an annealed crystal derived from the as-grown crystal).

relations.name: compared_with
relations.definition: The paper explicitly compares two samples, materials or processes (no superiority implied).
relations.mapping_note: Non-causal comparison; use structured comparison records for properties, baseline/target and conditions.
